Specialised Procedures

Advanced Surgical
Treatments & Techniques

Chennai's leading center for minimally invasive and complex abdominal wall repairs. Under the direction of Dr. Kumar, we combine robotic precision and decades of surgical mastery to achieve durable, patient-first results.

Primary Surgical Procedures & Repairs

Core surgical pathways for abdominal wall defects, hernias, and muscular separation.

Hernia Surgery Overview

A comprehensive diagnostic and surgical guide to groin (inguinal, femoral) and abdominal (umbilical, ventral, incisional) hernia repairs.

Learn More

Laparoscopic Hernia Surgery

Keyhole surgical repairs performed with tiny cameras and instruments, leading to minimal pain, faster discharge, and minor scars.

Learn More

Robotic Hernia Surgery

Robotic-assisted surgery using the da Vinci platform. Translates the surgeon's movements into micro-movements for maximum precision and safety.

Learn More

Abdominal Wall Reconstruction

Advanced restorative surgery for massive ventral/incisional hernias and loss of abdominal domain using component separation (TAR/CST).

Learn More

Diastasis Recti (Divarication)

Correction of core separation along the linea alba midline. Re-aligns muscles using advanced endoscopic plication (SCOLA) and robotic methods.

Learn More

Mesh Technology & Implants

Expert selection of modern mesh materials, including self-gripping mesh, 3D anatomical contours, and absorbable biological options.

Learn More

Advanced Techniques & Support Pathways

Specialized surgical methodologies and recovery systems ensuring absolute structural integrity.

TAPP Repair Technique

Transabdominal Preperitoneal repair. Keyhole groin surgery providing direct intra-abdominal overview for complex bilateral hernia cases.

Learn More

TEP Repair Technique

Totally Extraperitoneal groin repair. Keeps all surgical work within the preperitoneal layers, entirely avoiding the peritoneal abdominal cavity.

Learn More

eTEP Repair Technique

Enhanced Totally Extraperitoneal approach. Significantly enlarges the surgical working window to repair complex ventral, incisional, and groin hernias.

Learn More

Special Intra-op Techs

Innovative adjunct treatments (e.g. Botox injections, progressive pneumoperitoneum - PPP, and mechanical traction) for massive hernias.

Learn More

Post-Op Recovery & Rehab

Patient instructions for the immediate recovery period. Focuses on safe mobilization, dietary guidelines, and timeline warnings to prevent complications.

Learn More
